newsitem.title: GERMANY: Number one German network RTL shows April gains.
newsitem.headline: Number one German network RTL shows April gains.

text.p: Germany's top-rated RTL private television channel said on Friday it had increased its viewer share by nine percent in April, propelled by sports broadcasts and a popular evening of medical thrillers.

Citing figures from the GfK market research institute, RTL said it had captured 17.8 percent of viewers in April, up from 16.4 percent during the previous month. Station officials called the doctor-themed evening a ratings coup .
"We have succeeded in establishing a evening of television as a public event," programming director Marc Conrad said.

Public broadcaster ARD also showed gains for the month, with a 15 percent share marking a jump of 1.7 percentage points from March and pushing it into second place above the previous number two, Berlin-based private station Sat1.
Sat1 saw a slight drop in April from 14.6 percent to 14.1, while public channel ZDF landed in fourth place with 13.4 percent, up a percentage point from the previous month.
